sa: ते शरास्तमनासाद्य पुरंदररथध्वजम्। रथशक्तिं परामृश्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Those arrows reaching the flag staff of the Purandara chariot and perceiving its might fell down on the earth.

sa: दृष्ट्वा त्वामभिषेकाहं कौसल्यामभिवाद्य च। अचिरादागमिष्यामः स्वगृहानृपसत्तम॥
en: Beholding you installed and bowing to Kausalya, we shall soon return to our respective homes, O foremost of kings.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्। हरीन्सुग्रीवमुख्यास्त्वं स्नानेनोपनिमन्त्रय॥
en: Being thus accosted Kākutstha replied to Vibhīşaņa, saying: Do you invite all these monkeys headed by Sugrīva to bath.

sa: हुत्वाग्नि तर्पयित्वाथ देवदानवराक्षसान्। आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठमन्तर्धानगतं शुभम्॥
en: Thus offering oblations to fire and to celestials, Dänavas and Raksasas, he ascended in excellent car and soon disappeared.

sa: सोऽश्वकर्णदुमाशालांश्चूतांश्चापि सुपुष्पितान्। अन्यांश्च विविधान्वृक्षानीलश्चिक्षेप संयुगे।७५ ।।
en: In that encounter Nīla discharged Aśvakarņa trees, and sālas, and mangoes in full flower, and also various other trees.

sa: ततः श्वसनचन्द्रार्कसिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम्। पन्थानमहमाक्रम्य भवतो दृष्टवानिह ॥
en: And following the track of the Wind, the son, the Moon, Gandharvas, and Siddhas I have beheld you all.

sa: ततः स्वायम्भुवैमन्त्रैर्ब्रह्मास्त्रं चाभिमन्त्रितम्। हनूमांश्चिन्तयामास वरदानं पितामहात्॥
en: And that heroic monkey began to think of the boons conferred on him by the Great-father of the celestials.

sa: वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः। शुकस्य च महावेगः सारणस्य च धीमतः॥
en: And then that mighty monkey with a bound entered into the abode of Vahudanshtra. And then that leader of monkey-bands gifted with great speed leapt into the abode of Suka, and next into that of the intelligent Sarana.

sa: तेषामेवंप्रभावाणां युष्माकं राक्षसर्षभाः॥ कथं भयमसंबुद्धं मानुषादिदमागतम्।
en: O you foremost of the Rākşasas, how could this fear from man overwhelm you all who were so powerful.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दूरादंशुमन्तमिवोदितम्। ददृशुर्दीप्तमायान्तं विमानं तस्य रक्षसः॥
en: In the meanwhile they saw the Rākṣasa's car approach from afar, flaming and like to the rayfurnished (one) risen.

sa: नाहं स्वप्नमिमं मन्ये स्वप्ने दृष्ट्वा हि वानरम्। न शक्योऽभ्युदयः प्राप्तुं प्राप्तश्चाभ्युदयो मम॥
en: Nor do I regard this as dream. To behold a monkey in a dream dose not lead to prosperity whereas I have attained it. (Here prosperity means joy-Sītā attained an immense treasure of joy on beholding Rāma's messengerHanumãn.)

sa: नानाविकृतवेषाश्च नानाभूषणभूषिताः। पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतश्चैनं परिवार्य ययुस्तदा॥
en: And (some of) these, wearing various frightful suits, and decked with diverse ornaments, went, surrounding his rear and flanks.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्रुतं मे भवतो वाक्यमन्नदानस्य यो विधिः। नक्षत्रयोगस्येदानी दानकल्पं ब्रवीहि मे।।।।
en: Yudhishthira said I have heard your discourse about the ordinances for the gift of food. Do you describe to me now about the conjunctions of the planets and the stars in relation to the subject of making gifts.

sa: निस्तरेदेकभक्तेन वैशाख यो जितेन्द्रियः। नरो वा यदि वा नारी ज्ञातीनां श्रेष्ठतां व्रजेत्॥
en: The person, whether male or female, who passes the month of Baishakha, taking himself or herself every day one meal, and keeping his or her senses under restraint, succeeds in attaining to a position of eminence among kinsmen.

sa: यच्चादाय तदाज्ञप्तं भीतं दत्तं सुदारुणम्। यजेद् राजा न तं यज्ञं प्रशंसन्त्यस्य साधवः॥
en: And who spends the riches that is thus collected at his behest under circumstances of fear and cruelty, in the performance of sacrifices, should know that those sacrifices of his, are never highly spoken of by the pious.

sa: उलूपि साधु पश्येमं पतिं निपतितं भुवि। पुत्रं चेमं समुत्पाद्य घातयित्वा न शोचसि॥
en: See, O Ulupi, this beautiful form of your husband lying prostrate on the ground. How is it that you do not grieve, having cause him to be killed through your son whom you did excite with your words?

sa: एतदेव रहस्यं वः पद्मनाभस्य धीमतः। मया प्रोक्तं समासेन न भी: कार्या तपोधनाः॥
en: I have thus told you, in brief, a mystery belonging to Him who has the lotus for the origin and who is gifted with great intelligence. Ye Rishis having penances for wealth, you should not yield to fear.

sa: नित्यं शमपरा ये च तथा ये चानसूयकाः। नित्यस्वाध्यायिनो ये च दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: They who are always devoted to peacefulness of conduct as also they who are shorn of malice and envy, and they who are always attentive to the study of the Vedas, succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

sa: ददर्श चापि दूरेऽस्य मातरं शोककर्शिताम्। उलूप्या सहतिष्ठन्तीं ततोऽपृच्छद् धनंजयः॥ किमिदं लक्ष्यते सर्वे शाकविस्मयहर्षवत्। रणाजिरममित्रघ्न यदि जानासि शंस मे॥
en: He saw sitting at a distance from his son, this latter's mother stricken with grief, in the company of Ulupi. Dhanajaya asked, Why is it that every thing in the field of battle seems to bear the marks of grief, wonder and joy? If O destroyer of enemies, you know the cause, do you then tell me.

sa: अस्य नानासमायोगं यः पश्यति वृथामतिः। वियोगे शोचतेऽत्यर्थं स बाल इति मे मतिः॥
en: When such is the case he who sees a creature as disposed to take various forms, is considered as having an erroneous understanding. He who indulges in too much grief at separation, is, I think, a foolish person.

sa: अद्य ब्रह्मोत्तरं लोकं करिष्ये क्षत्रियोत्तरम्। न हि मे संयुगे कश्चित् सोढुमुत्सहते बलम्॥
en: This world that is now considered as having Brahmanas for its foremost dwellers. shall soon be made such as to have Kshatriyas for its foremost dwellers. There is none who is capable of withstanding my power in battle.

sa: अतो नियम्यते लोकः प्रच्यवन् धर्मवर्त्मसु। यश्च योगी च मुक्तश्च स एतेभ्यो विशिष्यते॥
en: It is by the conduct of the good that the world is restrained in the paths of Virtue when it falls away, He who is a Yogin is Liberated, and is, therefore, distinguished above these (viz., the good).

sa: आश्रमाणां च कर्तारः कुलानां चैव भारत। देशानां नगराणां च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who help in the establishment of asylums for ascetics, who be come founders of families, O Bharata, who open up new countries for purposes of dwelling and implant towns and cities, succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: शरीरमेतौ सृजतः पिता माता च भारत॥ आचार्यशास्ता या जाति: सा सत्या साजरामरा।
en: So far as the body is concerned, O Bharata, it is the father and the mother who creates it. That birth, however, which the Acharya ordains, is considered as the true birth which is really unfading and immortal.

sa: नरस्तु यो वेद गुणानिमान् सदा गुणान् स भुङ्क्ते न गुणैः स युज्यते।
en: The qualities which belong to goodness have been declared particularly. The conduct which those qualities form, has also been properly described. That man who always understands these qualities, succeeds in enjoying the qualities without being attached to them.

sa: राजोवाच महाननुग्रहो मेऽघ यस्त्वमेवमिहात्थ माम्। बाढमेव करिष्यामीत्युक्त्वासौ राजसत्तमः॥ उत्कृत्योत्कृत्य मांसानि तुलया समतोलयत्। अन्तःपुरे ततस्तस्य स्त्रियो रत्नविभूषिताः॥ हाहाभूता विनिष्क्रान्ताः श्रुत्वा परमदुःखिताः। तासां रुदितशब्देन मन्त्रिभृत्यजनस्य च॥
en: The king said Great is the favour you show me today by speaking to me thus. Yes, I shall do what you bid. Having said this that best of kings began to cut off his own flesh and weigh it in a balance against the pigeon. Meanwhile in the inner apartments of the palace, the queen adorned with jewels and gems, hearing what was taking place, uttered exclamations of woe and came out, stricken with grief.

sa: धर्मयुक्तानि कार्याणि व्यवहारन्वितानि च। धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञातो विदुरस्तान्यकारयत्॥
en: Vidura, under the order of Dhritarashtra, superintended the performance of all religious acts and the adıninistration of the law.

sa: तेभ्यश्चान्यांस्तेषु नित्यांश्च भावान् भूतात्मानं लक्षयेरशरीरे। तस्मिस्तिष्ठन्नास्मि सक्तः कथंचित् कामक्रोधाभ्यां जरया मृत्युना च॥
en: Separated from them are others; in them are eternal dispositions; Yogins would see in the body, the soul of all creatures. Living in that, I am never attached to anything through desire and anger, and decrepitude and death.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच मोक्षधर्मं समाश्रित्य कृष्ण यन्मामपृच्छथाः। भूतानामनुकम्पार्थं यत्मोहच्छेदनं विभो॥ तत् नेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावन्मधुसूदन। शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा गदतो मम माधव॥
en: Brahmana said That which you ask me, O Krishna, about the religion of Moksha (Emancipation), led by your compassion for all creatures, that, indeed, which destroys all delusion, O you gifted with Supreme power, I shall now tell you duly, O destroyer of Madhu. Do you listen with rapt attention as I discourse to you, O Madhava.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः कुशिकः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना। प्रोवाच मुनिशार्दूलमिदं वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: Thus addressed by the Rishi, king Kushika, with a pleased heart, replied to the Rishi in these pregnant words.

sa: पुनश्चासौ जनिं प्राप्य राजवत् स्यान्न संशयः। तस्मात् प्राप्यैव पृथिवीं दद्याद् विप्राय पार्थिवः॥
en: Upon being born again in this world, such a man, forsooth, attains to a position equal to that of a king. Hence, a king, as soon as he gets carth, should make gifts of earth to the Brahmanas.

sa: दिग्गजा ऊचुः कार्तिके मासि चाश्लेषा बहुलस्याष्टमी शिवा। तेन नक्षत्रयोगेन यो ददाति गुडौदनम्॥
en: Standing in the eight quarters, the elephants said, On the sacred eighth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Kartika when the constellation Ashlesha is in the ascendant, one should make gifts of treacle and rice.

sa: अनुग्रहं तु नागानां यं चक्रुः शृणु तं प्रभो। देवा भृगुकुलश्रेष्ठ प्रीत्या सत्यपराक्रमाः॥
en: Listen now, O powerful hero, what favour was shown to the elephants, O foremost one of Bhrigu's race; by the celestials of unbaffled prowess who were all pleased with the service one of their representatives had rendered them.

sa: गवामुष्णं पयः पीत्वा त्र्यहमुष्णं घृतं पिबेत्। त्र्यहमुष्णं घृतं पीत्वा वायुभक्षो भवेत् व्यहम्॥
en: Having thus drunk for three days hot milk, one should next drink hot clarified butter for three days. Having thus drunk hot clarified butter for three days, one should live for the next three days on air only.

sa: दोग्ध्रीणां वै गवां चापि प्रयुतानि दशैव ह। प्रादां दशगुणं ब्रह्मन् न तेनाहमिहागतः॥
en: I also gave away to the Brahmanas twice ten Prayutas of other kine, all giving milk, It is not through the merit of those gifts, O Brahman, that I have succeeded in acquiring to this region of happiness.

sa: इत्येतद् गोप्रदानं च तिलदानं च कीर्तितम्। तथा भूमिप्रदानं च शृणुष्वाने च भारत॥
en: Thus have I recited to you the merits of the gift of kine and of sesame, as also of the gift of earth. Listen now to me as I describe to you the gift of food, O Bharata.

sa: गर्दभ्युवाच ब्राह्मण्यां वृषलेन त्वं मत्तायां नापितेन ह। जातस्त्वमसि चाण्डालो ब्राह्मण्यं तेन तेऽनशत्॥
en: The She-ass said You were begotten upon a Brahmana woman worked up with desire, by a Shudra following the calling of a barber. You are therefore, a Chandala by birth. You have not the dignity of a Brahmana.

sa: प्रादुष्कृता यथान्यायमग्नयो वेदपारगैः। व्यराजन्त द्विजश्रेष्ठैस्तत्र तत्र तपोवने॥ प्रादुष्कृताग्निरभवत् स च वृद्धो नराधिपः।
en: Brahmanas knowing the Vedas duly ignited their sacred fires in that retreat of ascetics. Surrounded by those foremost of Brahmanas, those sacred fires shonc forth in beauty. The sacred fire of the old king was also lighted up.

sa: पौरजानपदाश्चैव यानैर्बहुविधैस्तथा। अन्वयुः कुरुराजानं धृतराष्ट्रं दिदृक्षवः॥
en: The citizens and inhabitants of the provinces, desirous of beholding Dhritarashtra, followed the king on various kinds of conveyances.

sa: उन्मुचुःप्रमुचुश्चैव स्वस्त्यात्रेयश्च वीर्यवान्। दृढव्यश्चोर्ध्वबाहुश्च तृणसोमाङ्गिरास्तथा॥ मित्रावरुणयोः पुत्रस्तथागस्त्यः प्रतापवान्। धर्मराजविजः सप्त दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिताः॥
en: Unmuchu, Pramuchu, Svastwyatreya of great energy, Dridhavya, Urdhavahu, Trinasoma Angirasa, and Agastya of great energy, the son of Mitravaruna, these seven are the Ritvijas of the Yama the king of the dead, and live in the southern quarter

sa: गुणार्थिनां गुणः कार्यो विदुषां वै जनाधिप। अविचार्याश्च ते ते स्युरचला इव नित्यशः॥
en: A wise king, O chief of men, should always see that the accomplishments of his subjects might be kept up. They would then be firinly devoted to you, seeing that they did not fall away from their skill

sa: यद् वेष्टितशिरा भुङ्क्ते यद् भुङ्क्ते दक्षिणामुखः। सोपानत्कश्च यद् भुङ्क्ते सर्वे विद्यात् तदासुरम्॥
en: A Brahmana who is blind stains sixty individuals of the line, one who is destitute of manly powers stains a hundred; while one who is afflicted with white leprosy stains as many as he looks upon, O king.

sa: सगणो गणकारश्च भूतवाहनसारथिः। भस्मशयो भस्मगोप्ता भस्मभूतस्तरुर्गणः॥
en: You are eternal Time; you are of the form of the Tortoise; you are adored by the Destroyer himself.

sa: तदैष तत्त्वतामेति न चापि मिश्रतां व्रजेत्। प्रकृत्या चैव राजेन्द्र मिश्रो ह्यन्यश्च दृश्यते॥
en: When Individual Soul ceases to exist in a state of union with Nature, then does he become at one with Brahima. When however, he exists united with Nature, he then, O king, seems to be different from Brahma.

sa: भवन्ति चात्र श्लोकाः-अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात् प्रतिनिवर्तते। स दत्त्वा दुष्कृतं तस्मै पुण्यमादाय गच्छति॥
en: There is a verse on this subject. If a guest goes away from a house with expectations not fulfilled, he is supposed to take away the merits of the householder and transfer to the latter all his sins.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अक्रोधना धर्मपरा: सत्यनित्या दमे रताः। तादृशा: साधवो विप्रास्तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: Bhishma said Those Brahmanas who are freed from anger, who are devoted to acts of virtue, who are firm in Truth, and who practise self-control, are considered as good. By making gifts to them one acquires great merit.

sa: वेदवेदाङ्गसंयुक्तान् यज्ञान् यज्ञाङ्गसंयुतान्॥ निर्ममे लोकसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। अष्टाभ्यः प्रकृतिभ्यश्च जातं विश्वमिदं जगत्।॥
en: Then the Grandfather of all the worlds, viz., Brahman, created, for the success of all creatures, the Vedas with all their branches as also the sacrifices with their limbs. From these eight elements have originated this vast universe.

sa: नारद उवाच अनाम्नायमला वेदा ब्राह्मणस्याव्रतं मलम्। मलं पृथिव्या वाहीका: स्त्रीणां कौतूहलं मलम्॥
en: Narada said The fault of the Vedas is the suspension of their recitation. The fault of the Brahmanas is their non-observance of vows. The Vahika race is the stain of the Earth. Curiosity is the fault of women.

sa: छित्त्वैनां सुकृतो यान्ति नैनां छिन्दन्ति दुष्कृतः। यो न हिंसति सत्त्वानि मनोवाक्कर्महेतुभिः॥ जीवितार्थापनयनैः प्राणिभिर्न स बुद्ध्यते। तस्मात् सत्यव्रताचारः सत्यव्रतपरायणः॥ सत्यकाम: समो दान्तः सत्येनैवान्तकं जयेत्। अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च द्वयं देहे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: The pious cut it and escape. The sinful can not cut it. He who does not injure other creatures in thought, word, and deed, and who never injures others by taking away their means of livelihood, is never injured by any crcature. Therefore, one should practise the vow of truth, be steadfastly devoted to the vow of truth, and should wish for nothing but the truth. Governing all his senses and regarding all creatures impartially, one should defeat Death with the help of Truth. Both Immortality and Death are in the body.

sa: कातिक्यामद्य भोक्तारः सहस्रं मे द्विजोत्तमाः। तत्रायमपि भोक्ता च देयमस्मे च मे धनम्॥
en: On this day of the month of Kartika, a thousand Brahmanas of the highest order are to be entertained in my house. This Gautama also shall be entertained with them and I shall give wealth to him too.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्य तु देहोऽयं न कामार्थाय जायते। इह क्लेशाय तपसे प्रेत्य त्वनुपमं सुखम्॥
en: A Brahmana has not been born for the gratification of senses. On the other hand, his body, for being subjected to mortification and penances in this world so that he may enjoy peerless happiness in the next world.

sa: वीरणचाप्यधीत्यैनं रैभ्याय मुनये ददौ। रैभ्यः पुत्राय शुद्धाय सुव्रताय सुमेधसे॥ कुक्षिनाम्ने स प्रददौ दिशां पालाय धर्मिणे। ततोऽप्यन्तर्दधे भूयो नारायणमुखोद्भवः॥
en: Having studied it in this way, Virana taught it to the ascetic Raivya. Raivya, in his turn, gave it to his son of pure soul, good vows, and great intelligence viz., Kukshi, that righteous Regent to the cardinal and subsidiary points. After this, that religion born of the mouth of Narayana, once more disappeared from the world.

sa: तेजसा शक्यते प्राप्तुमुपाय: सहचारिणा। इह च प्रेत्य च श्रेयस्तस्य मूलं धृतिः परा॥
en: He who is in the company of the righteous, succeeds, by his own energy, in acquiring the means of doing what is beneficial for him both here and hereafter. Verily, the root of that benefit is unflinching firmness.

sa: युद्धार्थिनौ हि विज्ञाय विबुद्धः पुरुषोत्तमः॥ निरीक्ष्य चासुरेन्द्रौ तौ ततो युद्धे मनो दधे।
en: The foremost of Beings, (viz., Narayana), thus awakened understood that the two Danavas intended to fight with him. Seeing the two foremost of Asuras prepared to battle with him, he also wished to satisfy that desire of theirs.

sa: अत्युग्रं तेजसां तेजस्तपां परमं तपः। विश्वावसुहिरण्याक्षपुरुहूतनमस्कृत॥
en: You, O powerful one, are the liberal giver of blessings. You are the supreme Truth. I bow to you.

sa: तेभ्यो हिरण्यं रत्नं वा गामश्वं वा ददाति यः। दश वर्षाणि विष्ठां स भुङ्क्ते निरयमास्थितः॥ मेदानां पुल्कसानां च तथैवान्तेवसायिनाम्। कृतं कर्माकृतं वापि रागमोहेन जल्पताम्॥
en: He who gives such persons gold or gems or king or horses has to sink in hell and there live for ten years, on the faces of such person as live upon the flesh of dead kine and buffaloes, of men called Pukkasas, of others who live in the outskirts of cities and villages, and of men who give out under the influence of anger and folly, the acts and omissions of others.

sa: शिरसा वन्दिते देवे देवी प्रीता झुमा तदा। ततोऽहमब्रुवं स्थाणुं स्तुतं ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरैः॥
en: After I had bowed to him, his wife, viz., the goddess Uma, became pleased with me. I then addressed in these words the great God whose praises are hymned by all the gods headed by the Grandfather Brahman.

sa: ततः स विप्रः कृतकर्मनिश्चयः कृताभ्यनुज्ञः स्वजनेन धर्मकृत्। यथोपदिष्टं भुजगेन्द्रसंश्रयं जगाम काले सुकृतैकनिश्चयः॥
en: Having dismissed his guest, the virtuous Brahmana, determined to achieve his purpose, took leave of his kinsmen and relatives, and started in due time for the abode of that foremost of Nagas, with heart firmly directed towards it.

sa: एतत सर्वं प्रतिच्छन्नं मयि नार्हसि गुहितुम्॥७० सा यदि त्वं स्वकार्येण यद्यन्यस्य महीपतेः। तत् त्वं सत्रप्रतिच्छन्ना मयि नार्हसि गुहितुम्॥
en: You should not conceal from me all your secret motives. You should not who thus disguise yourself, conceal from me what your object is, that is, whether this call of yours has been prompted by the desire of accomplishing some object of your own or whether you have come for accomplishing the object of some other king.

sa: चतुष्पात्पक्षिकीटानां प्राणिनां स्नेहसङ्गिनाम्। परलोकगतिस्थानां मुनियज्ञक्रिया इव॥
en: Like the sacrifice of the Rishis, the love of quadrupeds, of birds, and insects, yields no reward in heaven.

sa: नागामिनमनर्थं हि प्रतिघातशतैरपि। शक्नुवन्ति प्रतिव्योढुमृते बुद्धिबलान्नराः॥
en: Even by a thousand means, men cannot avert an impending danger. Intelligence and strength are useless in such cases.

sa: शुक उवाच यदिदं वेदवचनं लोकवादे विरुध्यते। प्रमाणे वाप्रमाणे च विरुद्ध शास्त्रता कुतः॥
en: The saying of the Vedas are, in the opinion of the ordinary person, contradictory. Whether on severe ! this is authoritative or that is so, when there is this conflict, how can they be considered to be spiritual.

sa: एवमुक्तस्य चैवाथ महादेवेन धीमता। हर्षादश्रूण्यवर्तन्त रोमहर्षस्त्वजायत॥
en: Thus' addressed by the highly wise Mahadeva, tears of joy came into my eyes and my hair stood crect.

sa: नावेदनिष्ठस्य जनस्य राजन् प्रदेयमेतत् परमं त्वया भवेत्। विधिसमानाय विबोधकारणं प्रबोधहेतोः प्रणतस्य शासनम्॥
en: You may communicate this high knowledge, capable of awakening the soul, to that person, O king, who though not a master of the Vedas is, nevertheless, humble and has a keen desire for acquiring the knowledge of Brahma.

sa: नैव दस्युर्मनुष्याणां न देवानामिति श्रुतिः। न गन्धर्वपितृणां च कः कस्येह न कश्चन॥
en: The robber has no connection with men, with the gods, with the Gandharvas, and with the Pitris. What is he to whom? He is not any was body to any one. This is the saying of the Shrutis.

sa: स तु धर्मो मृगो भूत्वा बहुवर्षोषितो वने। तस्य निष्कृतिमाधत्त न त्वसौ यज्ञसंविधिः॥
en: It was Dharına himself who had become a deer that lived in that forest for many years. Dharma provided for his salvation and advised him, saying,-This (destruction of living creatures) is not according to the ordinances about Sacrifice..

sa: द्वितीयं कारणं तत्र नान्यत् किंचन विद्यते। तद् देहं देहिनां युक्तं पञ्चभूतेषु वर्तते॥
en: About such a man's attainment of a second body the only cause is his accidental death. There is no second cause. That new body which embodied creatures obtain, comes into existence and becomes attached to Rudras and Pishachas.

sa: विप्रचित्तिप्रधानांश्च दानवानसृजद् दनुः। दितिस्तु सर्वानसुरान् महासत्त्वानजीजनत्॥
en: Danu gave birth to the Danavas having Viprachitti as their head. Diti gave birth to all the powerful Asuras.

sa: पितुराज्ञा परो धर्मः स्वधर्मो मातृरक्षणम्। अस्वतन्त्रं च पुत्रत्वं किं तु मां नानुपीडयेत॥
en: Obedience to the orders of the father forms the highest merit. The protection of the mother again is a clear duty. The condition of a son is fraught with dependence. How shall I avoid being affected by sin?

sa: एवमेकं सांख्ययोगं वेदारण्यकमेव च॥ परस्पराङ्गान्येतानि पाञ्चरात्रं च कथ्यते। एष एकान्तिनां धर्मो नारायणपरात्मकः॥
en: The Sankhya system, the Aranyaka-Veda, and the Pancharatra scriptures, are all identical and form parts of one whole. This is the religion of those who are devoted whole. mindedly to Narayana—the religion that has Narayana for its Soul.

sa: उच्छेदनिष्ठा नेहास्ति भावनिष्ठा न विद्यते। अयं ह्यपि समाहारः शरीरेन्द्रियचेतसाम्। वर्तते पृथगन्योन्यमप्यपाश्रित्य कर्मसु॥
en: In Liberation the consummation is not Extinction. Nur is that consummation any kind of Existence. What we see is a union of body senses, and mind. Existing independently as also depending on one another, these go on acting.

sa: एवमेतत् पुरावृत्तं तदा कथितवानृषिः। भार्गवोऽपि ददौ धनुर्वेदं महात्मने। १५७॥ कर्णाय पुरुषव्याघ्र सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना।
en: This is the old story, which then; the Rishi narrated (to my father). O foremost of persons, the son of Bhrigu handed over all that knowledge of archery to the high-souled Karna, being gratified in his inner heart.

sa: छिन्नगात्रैर्विकवचैर्विशिरस्कैः समन्ततः। पातितैश्च पतद्धिश्च योधैरासीत् समावृता॥
en: Warriors dead and dying, trunks without heads, lopped off portions of human bodies deprived of armour, covered the battle-field.

sa: अनुक्त्वा समरे तात शूरा युध्यन्ति शक्तित:। प्रयुध्यस्व मया शक्त्या हनिष्ये दर्पमेव ते॥
en: O sire, without speaking anything (highly of themselves) in the battle, the warriors fight to the best of their might. hence, do you fight with me to the best of your power. I will surely destroy your vanity.

sa: पदातिहयसंघानां प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। द्रोणेनैकेन नाराचैर्निर्भिन्नानि निशामुखे॥
en: Millions of foot-soldiers and hundreds of millions of horses were pierced with shafts by Drona alone at that night.

sa: इत्युक्ता भार्गवेणाथ दैत्या युद्धं प्रचक्रमुः। स तान् निहत्य समरे दैत्यान् भार्गवनन्दनः॥ वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शः प्रहारैरेव भार्गवः। स दानवैः क्षततनुर्जामदग्न्यो द्विजोत्तमः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by that descendent of Bhrigu's race, all the Daityas began to fight with him (Bhargava). Then that descendant of Bhrigu's race, that delighter of the race of Bhrigu, after having slaughtered those Daityas in the field of battle by means of strokes, that were like the touches of the thunder belonging to Indra.

sa: चतुरङ्गस्य सैन्यस्य सम्पातश्च महानभूत्। ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज कौरवाणामनीकिनीम्॥ व्यधमत् त्वरया युक्तः क्षपयन् सर्वपार्थिवान्।
en: Terrific, (indeed) was the clash of the two armies, (each) consisting of four (kinds of) forces. Then, 0 great king, Arjuna, vanquishing all the kings (on your son's side), began quickly to destroy the army of the Kauravas.

sa: दुश्चयावच्यावनो जेता हन्ता ब्रह्मद्विषां हरः। नित्यं त्राता च हन्ता त धर्माधर्माश्रितान् नरान्॥
en: Then that subduer of those, who can with difficulty be subdued, that victor that slayer of the antagonists of Brahman, that universal protector, that slayer of persons, with whom rest both righteousness and unrighteousness that One named Hara.

sa: वध्यमाने ततः सैन्ये द्रौपदेया महारथाः॥ सात्यकिधर्मराजश्च पञ्चालाश्चाप संगताः। त्यक्त्वा मृत्युभयं घोरं द्रौणायनिमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Thereupon, when their soldiers were being thus slaughtered, the mighty car-warriors, the son of Draupadi, Satyaki, the pious king Yudhishthira and the Panchalas, all united, giving up the dreadful fear of death, rushed towards the son of Drona.

sa: क्व युद्धं व मुनित्वं च वनं गच्छ वृकोदर। न त्वं युद्धोचितस्तात वनवासरतिर्भवान्॥
en: Vast is the difference, O Vrikodara, between fighting and the occupation of a hermit. So, do you repair to the forest O master; you are not capable of fighting and have an inclination for dwelling in the wood.

sa: नाकुलिस्तस्य विशिखैवर्म संनतपर्वभिः। गात्रात् संच्यावयामास तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: The son of Nakula, (also), with straight arrows cut-off his armour from his body and this feat seemed marvellous.

sa: स्वयं वैरं महत् कृत्वा पुत्राणां वचने स्थितः। उच्यमानो न गृह्णीघे मर्त्यः पथ्यमिवौषधम्॥
en: Accepting the counsels of your sons, it was you who provoked all those fierce hostilities. Though advised on the contrary, you did not pay any heed to those advices, like a dying man refusing to take proper medicines,

sa: पराजित्य तु संदृष्टः कृतवर्माणमाहवे। यन्तारमब्रवीच्छूरः शनैर्याहीत्यसंभ्रमम्॥
en: And vanquishing Kritavarman in battle, that hero Satyaki filled with joy, addressed his charioteer saying “Proceed slowly without fear.”

sa: मामनुस्मरती शेते वाहीकं कुरुजाङ्गले। शतद्रुकामहं तीर्खा तां च रम्यामिरावतीम्॥ गत्वा स्वदेश द्रक्ष्यामि स्थूलशङ्खा शुभाः स्त्रियः। मनः शिलोजवलापाङ्गयो गौर्यस्त्रिककुदाञ्जनाः॥
en: some Crossing the Sutlej, the charming Iravati and coming to my own country when shall I look at those beautiful women with thick frontal bones, with shining circles of red arsenic on their foreheads, with tinges of red, black collyrium on their eyes and their beautiful forms dressed in blankets and skins and themselves uttering shrill cries?

sa: संजय उवाच भीमसेनस्य राधेयः श्रुत्वा ज्यातलनि: स्वनम्। नामृष्यत यथा मत्तो गजः प्रतिगजस्वनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then the son of Radha hearing the sound of the twanging of Bhima's bow and of the slappings of his palm, did not brook it, like an infuriate elephant not brooking the roar of its rival.

sa: सतोमरावस्य भुजौ छिन्नौ भीमेन गर्जतः॥ तीक्ष्णैरग्निविप्रख्यैर्नाराचैर्दशभिर्हतः।
en: His two arms with Tomaras are cut-off by Bhima with ten sharpened Narachas effulgent like fire of the sun.

sa: दुःशासनस्य रुधिरे पीयमाने महात्मना। व्यापनचेतसश्चैव शोकोपहतचेतसः॥ दुर्योधनमुपासन्ते परिवार्य समन्ततः। कृपप्रभृतश्चैते हतशेषाः सहोदताः॥
en: When Dushasana blood has been quaffed by the brave-hearted Bhima. Kripa with others and the surviving brothers of the king, with painful hearts their rage depressed with sorrow, are all seated round Duryodhana and taking care of him.

sa: विचित्रमणिचित्रांश्च जातरूपपरिष्कृतान्। अश्वास्तरपरिस्तोमान् राङ्कवान् पतितान् भुवि॥
en: A number of riding-seats gem-studded, trimmed by gold fibres, made of Ranka stag's hide are now on the ground.

sa: मृदङ्गेष्वपि राजेन्द्र वाद्यमानेष्वनेकशः। महारथाः समाख्याता दुर्योधनहितैषिणः॥
en: And Mridangas, O mighty monarch, were sounded by thousands, great car-warriors, befriending the Kurus and desirous of Duryodhana's good.

sa: शरवातैः सुनिशितैः सुतीक्ष्णैः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। दुर्योधनस्य वृद्ध्यर्थं राधेयो रथिनां वरः॥ दिव्यास्त्रविन्महातेजाः कर्णो वैकर्तनो वृषः। सेनागोपश्च स कथं शत्रुभिः परमास्त्रवित्॥ घातितः पाण्डवैः शूरैः समरे वीर्यशालिभिः।
en: By means of his sharpened and keen arrows, that were adorned with the Kanka feathers for the sake of Duryodhana's aggrandisement. That one (Karna) was still waiting in the field for winning victory (for Duryodhana). How was that protector of armies (on my side), that one well-versed in the use of weapons, viz. Vaikartana Karna was slain in battle by the foes, the heroic sons of Pandu, who were possessed of immense strength?

sa: तु तदस्य कर्मातिमनुष्यकर्मणः समीक्ष्य हृष्टाः कुरवोऽभ्यपूजयन्। पराक्रमज्ञास्तु धनंजयस्य ये हुतोऽयमग्नाविति ते मेनिरे॥
en: All Kauravas filled with ecstasy to see this phenomenal valour of Vrishasena and they started appreciating him again and again. However, the people known of Arjuna's valour, understood it definitely that this Vrishasena will become morsel of fire.

sa: सहदेवस्तु तानश्वांस्तीक्ष्णैर्बाणैरवाकिरत्। पीड्यमानाः शरैश्चाशु प्रादूर्वन्ते ततस्ततः॥
en: Sahadeva, however, covered Dushasana steeds with sharp arrows and these, afflicted with those arrows, began to run away wildly.

sa: युधि वाप्यवमानो मे न कर्तव्यः कथञ्चन। पश्य पीनौ मम भुजौ वज्रसंहननौ पमौ॥
en: See these two my mascular arms, that can smite down like thunder; as also do you behold my bow that is variegated with the excellent colors, as well as my shafts that are like snakes possessing virulent poison.

sa: निशायां प्रत्यदृश्यन्त मेघा इव सविद्युतः। ऋषिशक्तिगदाबाणमुसलप्रासपट्टिशाः॥
en: Looked like clouds with lightning playing upon them during the night. Swords, darts, maces, scimitars, clubs, lances and axes.

sa: नूनमात्मविनाशाय पाण्डवेन किरीटिना। कर्ण जयद्रथवधं प्रति॥
en: Surely, O Karna, the diadem-decked son of Pandu had vowed the slaughter of Jayadratha for encompassing his own destruction.

sa: ततश्च कृतवर्माणं विद्धि राजञ्जनाधिपम्। तमप्रतिमकर्माणं क्षत्रियर्षभसत्तमम्॥
en: O king, know that Kritavarma that king of men, that man of matchless deeds, that best of best Kshatriyas,

sa: सामात्यो राजलिङ्गानि सोऽपनीय नराधिपः। पुरोहितसहायश्च जगामाश्रममुत्तमम्॥
en: The king, having laid aside all signs of royalty, entered that excellent hermitage with his Minister and Priest only.

sa: अभवंश्चामृतस्पर्शाद्दर्भास्तेऽथ पवित्रिणः। एवं तदमृतं तेन हृतमाहतमेव च। द्विजिह्वाश्च कृताः सर्पा गरुडेन महात्मना॥
en: The Kusha grass, from the contact of the Ambrosia, became sacred from that day. Thus did the illustrious Garuda bring the Ambrosia and bring it for the snakes, and thus were their tongues divided by what he did.

sa: तेत्वतीत्य जनाकीर्णाः कक्षास्तिस्रो नरर्षभाः। अहंकारेण राजानमुपतस्थुर्गतव्यथाः॥
en: Passing through three rooms crowded with men those best of men, with pride and cheerfulness came to the king.

sa: नास्तिक्यमनृतं क्रोधं प्रमादं दीर्घसूत्रताम्। अदर्शनं ज्ञानवतामालस्यं पञ्चवृत्तिताम्। एकचिन्तनमनामनर्थज्ञैश्च चिन्तनम्॥ निश्चितानामनारम्भं मन्त्रस्यापरिरक्षणम्। मङ्गलाद्यप्रयोगं च प्रत्युत्थानं च सर्वतः॥ कच्चित्वं वर्जयस्येतान् राजदोषांश्चतुर्दश। प्रायशो यैर्विनश्यन्ति कृतमूलापि पार्थिवाः॥
en: Do you keep yourself aloof from the fourteen vices of kings namely, atheism, untruthfulness, anger, carelessness, procrastination, non-visiting the wise, idleness, restlessness of mind, taking counsel with one man only, consultation with persons ignorant of the science of Artha, abandonment of a settled plain divulgence of counsels, unaccomplishment of beneficial projects and undertaking everything without reflection? O king, even those kings that are firmly seated on their thrones are ruined by these (vices).

sa: शुभं दिव्यममानाममृतस्याकरं परम्। अप्रमेयमचिन्त्यं च सुपुण्यजलसंमितम्॥
en: It was holy, the great receptacle of the Arabrosia of the celestials, immeasurable and inconceivable, full of holy waters.

sa: तत्प्रधानात्मनस्तस्य भूमेः कृत्यं स्वयंभुवः। पूर्वमेवाभवद्राजन्विदितं परमेष्ठिनः॥
en: O king, the object (for which she came) was already known beforehand to the Omniscient, Self-created and Supreme Lord.

sa: संदष्टदशनाश्चान्ये समुत्पेतुरनेकशः। ततस्तेऽतीव घूर्णन्तः पुनरग्नौ प्रपेदिरे॥
en: Many rose high upwards, biting their nether lips, but they soon again fell below whirling into the blazing fire.

sa: निरोंकारवषट्काराः स्वधास्वाहाविवर्जिताः। विनाऽग्निना प्रजाः सर्वास्तत आसन्सुदुःखिताः॥
en: Without the fire being deprived of Oms and Vashats, of Svadhas and Svahas, all creatures became very much distressed.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु सम्भ्रान्तजने समाजे विक्षिप्तवादेषु जनाधिपेषु। कुन्तीसुतो जिष्णुरियेष वर्तुं सज्यं धनुस्तत् सरं प्रवीरः॥
en: At last when that assemblage of kings of noble births became the subjects of derisive talk, that foremost of heroes Jishnu (Arjuna), the son of Kunti, desired to string the bow and place the arrows on the string.

sa: व्रजन्पथि महाबाहुर्दृष्टवान् पवनात्मजम्। कदलीषंडमध्यस्थं हनूमन्तं महाबलम्॥
en: His meeting on his way with the Pandava's son, greatly powerful, Hanumana, who was in a grove of bananas;

sa: स्वसारमुद्यम्य तदा जरत्कारुमृषि प्रति। सर्पान्बहूञ्जरत्कारौ नित्ययुक्तान्समादधत्॥
en: A large number of them who are always attentive to their duties, to watch the Rishi Jaratkaru. He said,

sa: मुहुर्मुहुः परावृत्य दृष्ट्वा सीतामनाथवत्॥ चेष्टन्तीं परतीरस्थां लक्ष्मणः प्रययावथ। दूरस्थे रथमालोक्य लक्ष्मणं च मुहुर्मुहुः। निरीक्षमाणां तूद्विग्नां सीतां शोकः समाविशत्।।२५
en: And casting his looks behind behind while proceeding he espied that Sītā, on the other side of the Gangă, was rowing wildly like one having none to look after her. Looking again and again when Sītā saw that Lakşmaņa and the chariot have gone beyond the range of her vision, she became overwhelmed with anxiety and grief.

sa: विचित्रवीर्यं च तदा बालमप्राप्तयौवनम्। कुरुराज्ये महाबाहुरभ्यषिञ्चदनन्तरम्॥
en: Thereupon, he installed the mighty armed boy Vichitravirya, still in his minority, on the throne of the Kuru kingdom.

sa: शक्रश्चापि तयोर्वीर्यमुपलभ्यासकृद् रणे॥ बभूव परमप्रीतो भूयश्चैतावयोधयत्
en: Indra also, seeing that great prowess in the battle. Became exceedingly pleased; and he once more rushed upon them.

sa: यदाश्रौषं त्रिदिवस्थं धनंजयं शक्रात्साक्षाद्दिव्यमस्त्रं यथावत्। अधीयानं शंसित सत्यसन्धं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the just and famous Arjuna had gone to the land of the celestials and had there obtained celestial weapons from Indra, the king of the gods.

sa: तयोर्वेगेन महता पृथिवी समकम्पत। पादपांश्च महाकायांचूर्णयामासतुस्तदा॥
en: The earth trembled in consequence of their great strength and large trees that stood there were broken to pieces.

sa: द्रौपदी प्रार्थयन्तस्ते स्वयंवरदिदृक्षया। पञ्चालानभितो जग्मुर्यत्र कौतूहलान्विताः॥
en: And also moved by the desire to win the hand of Draupadi, the departure of the Pandavas to Panchala;

sa: या दुस्त्यजा दुर्मतिभिर्या न जीर्यति जीर्यतः। योऽसौ प्राणान्तिको रोगस्तां तृष्णां त्यजतः सुखम्।१४
en: The thirst (of enjoyments), which is difficult to be cast off by the wicked, which does not fail even with falling life, is truly a fatal disease in man. To get rid of this thirst is real happiness.

sa: जयश्च नियतो राज्ञः स्वर्गश्च तदनन्तरम्। यस्य स्याद् धर्मविद् वाग्मी पुरोधाः शीलवान् शुचिः।।
en: That king becomes ever victorious (in this world) and obtains heaven in the next, who has a priest, who is learned in the precepts of morals, who is a master of words and who is pure and well-behaved.

sa: तमाश्रममनुप्राप्तं नैमिषारण्यवासिनाम्। चित्राः श्रोतुं कथास्तत्र परिवस्तपस्विनः॥
en: (Thereupon) desirous of hearing his wonderful stories, the ascetics addressed him who had come to their hermitage of Naimisharanya.

sa: पाटलैर्नारिकेलैश्च चन्दनैश्चार्जुनैस्तथा। एतै रम्यैर्महावृक्षैः पुण्यैः स्वादुफलैर्युतम्॥
en: Patala, Narikela, Chandana, Arjuna and various other beautiful, sacred and great trees, full of fragrant flowers and sweet fruits.

sa: विभ्राजमाना वपुषा बिभ्रती रूपमुत्तमम्। प्रह्लादशिष्यो नग्नजित्सुबलश्चाभवत्ततः॥
en: A girl of fascinating features and great beauty. Then was born the disciples of Pralhad, namely Nagnajit and Subala.

sa: महर्षेर्दर्शनं चैव व्यासस्यामिततेजसः। तदाज्ञयैकचक्रायां ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने॥
en: The meeting of the Pandavas with Vyasa, their stay according to his advice in a Brahmana's house at Ekachakra.

sa: नादेन रिपुसैन्यानां येषां संज्ञा प्रणश्यति। स तं नानापताकाभिः शोभितं रथसत्तमम्॥ प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य दैवतेभ्यः प्रणम्य च। संनद्धः कवची खङ्गी बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्रकः॥
en: Whose roars caused the soldiers of the enemy's army to faint away. Then walking round that excellent car adorned with various flags and banners and bowing to the celestial, Arjuna, attired in armour, armed with sword and his fingers increased in leather, ascended it as a virtuous man (on a celestial car that takes him to heaven).

sa: तस्माद्भक्ष्यं त्वमपरं भगवन्प्रदिशस्व मे। यद्भुक्त्वाऽमृतमाहर्तुं समर्थः स्यामहं प्रभो॥ क्षुत्पिपासाविघातार्थं भक्ष्यमाख्यातु मे भवान्।
en: O great one, point out to me some other food, by eating which, O Lord, I would become capable to bring the Ambrosia by force. You should point out some food which can appease my hunger and thirst.

sa: ददृशुस्तं महीपालमयोध्यावासिनो जनाः। पुरोहितेन सहितं दिवाकरमिवोदितम्॥
en: The citizens of Ayodhya saw the king accompanied by his priest (Vasishtha), as if he were the rising sun.

sa: स्तथा विसंज्ञाश्रुकलाश्च मातरः। तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं प्रतुष्टवुः प्रणम्य रामं च ययाचिरे सह॥
en: Then the Rtvijas, the citizens, and their leaders, and the mothers with their senses lost and with tears in their eyes, extolled Bharata as he was speaking thus; and, bowing down to Rāma, they directed their solicitations together.

sa: माद्रीसुतस्तस्य समुद्यतं तं प्रासं सुवृत्तौ च भुजौ रणाये। भल्लैस्त्रिभिर्युगपत् संचकर्त ननाद चोचैस्तरसाऽऽजिमध्ये॥
en: However with three broad-headed arrows, the son of Madri cut off at the same time without losing a moment that uplifted lance as also the two plump arms of his enemy and then sent up a loud war-cry.

sa: क्षमावाननपत्यश्च सत्यवान् विजितेन्द्रियः। अतिक्रान्तेन वयसा संतापमुपजग्मिवान्॥
en: But that truthful and self-controlled monarch having no offspring, was much pained when he was far advanced in years.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। रिरक्षिषन्तः पाञ्चाल्यं धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः॥
en: Headed by king Yudhishthira himself rushed at the son of Ganga, desirous of rescuing the Panchalas headed by Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: पितामहैराचरितं तथैव प्रपितामहैः॥ अद्योपादाय तं मार्गमभिषिक्तोऽनुपालय।
en: Being installed this day do you following in the footsteps of your fathers and grand-fathers cherish and protect us.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। दृष्ट्वा लङ्कां प्रदग्धां तां विस्मयं परमं गताः॥
en: Thereupon beholding Lankā burnt down, the celestials along with Gandharvas, Siddhās, and the great ascetics, were struck with wonder. And having consumed ihe city of Lankä, the great monkey quenched the fire of his tail in the Ocean.

sa: पुनश्चान्याशरान् पीतानकुण्ठाग्राशिलाशितान्। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो विकर्णाय महाबलः॥
en: Again that mighty car-warrior viz., the son of Subhadra shot at Vikarna other arrows, well tempered, kcen-pointed and straight-coursing.

sa: सत्यवती उवाच सत्यमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि भारत। विश्वासात् ते प्रवक्ष्यामि संतानाय कुलस्य नः॥
en: Satyavati said : O descendant of the Bharata race, what you say is true. From my confidence in you, I shall now point my confidence in you, I shall now point out the means of perpetuating our dynasty.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणु राजन्निदं चित्रं पूर्वकल्पे यथातथम्। आदौ कृतयुगे राजन् वर्तमाने यथाविधि॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Listen, O king, to this wonderful history as it took place in a previous Kalpa. In days of Yore, in the Satya Yoga, O king, all the celestials, duly approaching Varuna, said to him these words.

sa: युधिष्ठिरपुरोगांश्च सर्वसैन्येन पाण्डवान्। अन्वधावन्महाराज पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव॥
en: Your son Duryodhana then, O monarch, with all his troops, rushed against the Pandavas with Yudhishthira at the head.

sa: दुर्वासा उवाच वृथा पाकेन राजर्षेरपराधः कृतो महान्। मास्मानधाक्षुर्दृष्ट्वैव पाण्डवाः क्रूरचक्षुषा॥ स्मृत्वानुभावं राजर्षेरम्बरीषस्य धीमतः। बिभेमि सुतरां विप्रा हरिपादाश्रयाज्जनात्॥ पाण्डवाश्च महात्मानः सर्वे धर्मपरायणाः। शूराश्च कृतविद्याश्च वतिनस्तपसि स्थिताः॥ सदाचाररता नित्यं वासुदेवपरायणाः। क्रुद्धास्ते निर्दहेयुर्वै तूलराशिमिवानलः। तत एतानपृष्ट्वैव शिष्याः शीघ्रं पलायत॥
en: Durvasa said : By uselessly making him prepare our food we have done a great wrong to that royal sage. Will not the Pandavas distroy us by looking down upon us with angry eyes? I know, the royal sage is endued with great ascetic power; O Brahmana, I am afraid of those man who are devoted to Hari's feet. All those Pandavas are high-souled, pious, heroic, learned, observant of vows and of devout panances. They always observe the rules of good conduct and are devoted to Vasudeva; if angry, they can consume us with their anger as fire does a bale of cotton. So O disciples, you all run away quickly without seeing them.

sa: अगस्त्यसहिता देवाः सगन्धर्वमहोरगाः। ऋषयश्च महाभागाः समासेदुर्महोदधिम्॥
en: The celestials, the Gandharvas, the great Nagas, the greatly exalted Rishis, all came with Agastya to the great ocean.

sa: दानं हि भूताभयदक्षिणायाः सर्वाणि दानान्यधितिष्ठतीह। तीक्ष्णां तनुं यः प्रथमं जहाति सोऽऽनन्त्यमाप्नोत्यभयं प्रजाभ्यः॥
en: The gift of assurances of harmlessness to all creatures is superior in point of merit all other gifts. He who, at the beginning, promises abstention from injury, acquires Liberation whence is the assurance of harınlessness to all creatures.

sa: आत्मानं मोक्षयित्वाथ क्षितावभ्यवपद्यत। हनूमानुन्ममाथाशु निकुम्भं मारुतात्मजः॥
en: And releasing himself from the grasp of Nikumbha, Hanumān the Wind-god's son instantly planted his foot on the earth.

sa: नियुतं रक्षसामत्र दक्षिणद्वारमाश्रितम्। चतुरङ्गेण सैन्येन योधास्तत्राप्यनुत्तमाः॥
en: And a lac of Rākşasas with a fourfold force, and with the flower of the soldiery-protect the Southern gate.

sa: अथ कश्चित् कृतप्रज्ञः शृगाल: स्वार्थपण्डितः॥ सखिभिय॑वसत् सार्धं व्याघ्राखुवृकबभ्रुभिः। तेऽपश्यन् विपिने तस्मिन् बलिनं मृगयूथपम्॥ अशक्ता ग्रहणे तस्य ततो मन्त्रममन्त्रयन्।
en: The Jackal was wise and mindful of his own interest. He lived in the company of four friends, namely a tiger, a wolf, a mouse and a mongoose. They saw in the woods a strong deer, the leader of a herd, whom however they could not seize for his fleetness and strength. Thereupon they held a consultation.

sa: स एष पाण्डोर्दायाद्यं यदि प्राप्नोति पाण्डवः। तस्य पुत्रो ध्रुवं प्राप्तस्तस्य तस्यापि चापरः॥
en: If the son of Pandu now obtains the kingdom as his inheritance from Pandu, then his son will obtain it after him; that son's son also and so on, it will thus for ever descend on Pandu's line.

sa: सर्वमेतदशेषेण श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र विप्रर्षिगणसंनिधौ॥ देवराजसमो ह्यासीद् ययातिः पृथिवीपतिः। वर्धनः कुरुवंशस्य विभावसुसमद्युतिः॥ तस्य विस्तीर्णयशसः सत्यकीर्तेर्महात्मनः। चरितं श्रोतुमिच्छामि दिवि चेह च सर्वशः॥
en: O Brahmana, let this be narrated by you before all these Brahmana Rishis. The lord of the earth Yayati was like the king of the celestials (Indra). He was the progenitor of the exhaustive Kuru race; he was as effulgent as the sun. He was illustrious, world-wide famous and a man of wonderful achievements. I desire to hear in full the story of his life both here in this world and in heaven.

sa: न च मे स्तोकमप्यासीद् दुःखीमीर्ष्याकृतं तदा। तथा स राजमार्गेण महता निर्ययौ बहिः॥
en: Secing this, I did not feel the slightest grief bom of malice or the desire to injure the Rishi. Having yoked Rukmini to the car, he went out, desirous of passing along the high road of the city.

sa: श्रुत्वा च जीवतः पार्थान् पौरजानपदा जनाः। बलवद् दर्शने हृष्टास्तेषां राजन् प्रियं कुरु॥
en: O king, having heard that the sons of Pritha are alive, the men of the city and the country have become exceedingly glad; and they are all eager to see them. Do what will be agreeable to them.

sa: अथोक्तश्च महाराज राजा गन्धर्वसत्तमः। पृष्टवाननुपूर्वेण प्रश्नमर्थविदुत्तमम्॥
en: After king Vishvavasu, that foremost of Gandharvas, had asked me these questions one after another, I answered them duly.

sa: नागराडिव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥ राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च यातुधानास्तथैव च।
en: That gigantic Rakshasa looking like the prince of mountains, disappeared then and there. Then numerous Rakshasas, Pisachas, Yatudhanas and.

sa: अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यामिष्ट्वा विश्वजिता अपि। वाजपेयसहस्राणां सहस्रश्च सुसंवृतैः॥
en: He performed also such other sacrifices, as the Agnisthoma, the Atiratra, the Vektha, the Visvajit and thousands of Vajapeyas.

sa: जीवनाय समाक्लिन्नं वसु दत्त्वा महीयते। वैश्यं तु वासयेद् यस्तु सर्वयज्ञैः स इष्टवान्॥
en: O ruler of earth, he who gives food to one who is dying of hunger and he who founds a home of charity with a person to look after it both acquire the fruits of (performing) all sacrifices.

sa: सुखं त्विदानी त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ। अभ्यासाद् रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति॥ यत्तदने विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्। तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्॥
en: Now hear from Me, O best of Bharata race, what are the three kinds of happiness. Sattva Happiness is that in which one finds pleasure from repetition of enjoyment, which brings an end to all pain, which is like poison in the beginning, but ambrosia afterwards, which is born out of serenity, and is produced by knowledge.

sa: वीर्यशुल्केति मे कन्या स्थापितेयमयोनिजा। भूतलादुत्थितां तां तु वर्धमानां ममात्मजाम्॥ वरयामासुरागत्य राजानो मुनिपुङ्गव। तेषां वरयतां कन्यां सर्वेषां पृथिवीक्षिताम्॥ वीर्यशुल्केति भगवन् न ददामि सुतामहम्। ततः सर्वे नृपतयः समेत्य मुनिपुङ्गव॥ मिथिलामप्युपागम्य वीर्यं जिज्ञासवस्तदा।
en: Unsprung from the usual source, she was then established here as my daughter, whose hand must be obtained by bending the bow. And, O foremost of ascetics, many a king, coming here, had saught to obtain my growing daughter arisen from the earth. But, O worshipful one, in consideration of her being one whose dower must be prowess in bending the bow, I would not bestow my daughter upon those lords of earth seeking for the kings in a body began to flock to Mithila, desirous of being acquainted with the strength of the bow.

sa: एवमन्तर्हिते तस्मिन्पुष्पके सुकृतात्मनि॥ भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम्।
en: And the holy Puşpaka car having thus vanquished, Bharata with folded palms, said to Rama, the delight of Raghu.

sa: ब्रह्मणः सुमहातेजास्तपोबलसमन्वितः। उद्धरिष्यति रम्भे त्वां मत्क्रोधकलुषीकृताम्॥
en: And a highly energetic Brāhmaṇa equipped with ascetic energy, will, O Rambha, deliver you, stained because of my ire.'

sa: इमौ कुमारौ भद्रं ते देवतुल्यपराक्रमौ। गजसिंहगती वीरौ शार्दूलवृषभोपमौ॥ पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षौ खङ्गतूणधनुर्धरौ। अश्विनाविव रूपेण समुपस्थितयौवनौ॥ यदृच्छयेव गां प्राप्तौ देवलोकादिवामरौ। कथं पद्भयामिह प्राप्तौ किमर्थं कस्य वा मुने॥
en: Good betide you, boasting the prowess of celestials of elephantine or leonine gait, heroic, resembling tigers or bulls, possessed of come expansive eyes like lotus-patals, bearing scimitars and bows and quivers, like to the Aśvins in grace, endowed with youth, like to celestials fancy-led, descended from ethereal regions to the earth beneath, whose sons; O ascetic, are these boys, and what for have they come hither, and why also is it that they journey of foot?

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु राक्षस्या शूर्पनख्या परंतपः। ऋजुबुद्धितया सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Thus accosted by the Rākṣasī, Śūrpanakhă, that subduer of his foes from sincerity of disposition began to relate everything;

sa: तस्मादपरितापः संस्त्वमप्यनुविधाय माम्। प्रतिसंहारय क्षिप्रमाभिषेचनिकी क्रियाम्॥
en: Do you therefore assuage your grief and follow me and intercept speedily the collection of materials for my installation.

sa: पारिप्लवशतैर्जुष्टा बर्हिक्रौञ्चविनादिता। रमणीया नदी सौम्य मुनिसङ्घनिषेविता॥
en: This pleasant and picturesque stream is filled with various water fowls and Chakravākas and served by many a saint.

sa: अङ्गदस्तु कुमारोऽयं वनान्तमुपनिर्गतः। प्रवृत्तिस्तेन कथिता चारैरासीनिवेदिता॥
en: He has related to me all about Sugrīva, what he heard from his emmissaries while journeying in the forest.

sa: ततः सचिवसंदिष्टा हरयो रोमहर्षणाः। गिरिकुञ्जरमेधाभा नगरानिर्ययुस्तदा॥
en: Thereupon those terrible monkeys, resembling hills, elephants and clouds, went out of the city being commanded by the minister.

sa: त्वया सान्त्वैरुपक्रान्तं प्रसन्नेन्द्रियमानसम्। ततः मलपत्राक्षं द्रक्ष्याम्यहमरिंदमम्॥
en: Approaching him do you console him and thereafter I shall see that conqueror of foes having eyes resembling lotus-petals.

sa: अनाथो हतराज्योऽहं रावणेन च धर्षितः। दीनो दूरगृहः कामी मां चैव शरणं गतः॥
en: Regarding me as one without any to back him, deprived of his kingdom, insulted my Rāvaņa, wretched, of a distant land, under the influence of amour and therefore seeking his help, (Sugrīva has not felt pity for me).

sa: सैषा शापकृतामर्षां ताटका क्रोधमूर्च्छिता। देशमुत्सादयत्येनमगस्त्याचरितं शुभम्॥
en: Thus cursed by Agastya, Tățakā, overwhelmed with rage, lays waste this fair region, where Agastya carry on his austerities.

sa: चारयन्तस्ततश्चक्षुर्दृष्टवन्तो महद् बिलम्। लतापादपसंछन्नं तिमिरेण समावृतम्॥
en: And casting our eyes around, we spyed a huge cave covered with trees and plants and enveloped in gloom.

sa: सुपर्णवचनं श्रुत्वा सोंऽशुमानतिवीर्यवान्। त्वरितं हयमादाय पुनरायान्महातपाः॥
en: O hero, Hearing Suparna's speech, the exceedingly powerful Ansumat of mighty asceticism speedily taking the horse, retraced his steps.

sa: ततः प्रचलिताश्वेन रथेन रथिनां वरः। हरीनभ्यपतराच्छरजालैरकम्पनः॥
en: Then on a car drawn by moving steeds, Akampana from a distance attacked the monkeys with showers of arrows.

sa: गुरुलाघवमर्थानामारम्भे कर्मणां फलम्। दोषं वा यो न जानाति स बाल इति होच्यते।७।।
en: He that on the eve of beginning an action either relating to this world or the next, does not take into consideration the fact that actions entail consequences light or grave, disagreeable (or otherwise), is styled a child.

sa: साध्या ऊचुः साध्या देवा वयमेते महर्षे दृष्ट्वा भवन्तं न शक्नुमोऽनुमातुम्। श्रुतेन धीरो बुद्धिमांस्त्वं मतो नः काव्यां वाचं वक्तुमर्हस्युदाराम्॥
en: The Saddhyas said We are deities called Saddhyas. O great Rishi, seeing you, we are unable to guess who you are; but it seems to us that you are possessed of self-control and thorough acquaintance with the holy books. It is, therefore, most proper that you should discourse to us in the magnanimous words full of wisdom.

sa: प्रज्ञाचक्षुर्यः प्रणेता कुरूणां बहुश्रुतो वृद्धसेवी मनीषी। तस्मै राज्ञे स्थविरायाभिवाद्य आचक्षीथाः संजय मामरोगम्॥
en: Saluting the aged king too, who sees by the eyes of wisdom, is the leader of the Kurus, of great learning, who waits upon the old and wise, you should tell him that I am without any disease.

sa: ज्येष्ठस्य पाण्डुपुत्रस्य भागो मद्राधिपो बली। तौ तु तत्राब्रुवन् केचिद् विषमौ नो मताविति॥
en: The ruler of the Madras, endued with strength, has been reserved as the share of the eldest son of Pandu, through somebody in their party said that he was of opinion that the two did match very well.

sa: नदद्धिश्च महानागैर्हेषमाणैश्च वाजिभिः। भेरीशङ्खनिनादैश्च स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्॥
en: The huge elephants roaring, the horses neighing and the bugles and conchs being sounded, there arose a great tumult.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्मादवतीर्य रथोत्तमात्। बाष्पेणापिहितां सीतां ददशेक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः॥
en: Hearing these words, Rama, the descendant of Kakustha got down from that excellent car and saw Sita weeping profusely.

sa: ततोऽन्ये बहुसाहस्रा विचित्राद्भुतवाससः। असिप्रासायुधधराः कृष्णस्यासन् पुरःसराः॥
en: And there were others by thousands, who in diverse and strange attires holding swords, lances and axes followed Krishna.

sa: विदुर उवाच शूद्रयोनावहं जातो नातोऽन्यद् वक्तुमुत्सहे। कुमारस्य तु या बुद्धिर्वेद तां शाश्वतीमहम्॥
en: Vidura said I am born among the Shudra class; for that reason, I do not dare say anything more (than what I have already said); the knowledge of that celebrate being, however, is considered by me as eternal.

sa: एतानि सर्वाण्युपसेवमानः स देवराज्यं मघवान् प्राप मुख्यम्। बृहस्पतिर्ब्रह्मचर्यं चचार समाहितः संशितात्मा यथावत्॥
en: Devoting himself to all these, Indra got the high position of the king of the gods. Brihaspati too practised the austerities of a Brahmacharya life, with his mind shut up everything else and controlling his self as usual.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स्वाध्याय एषां देवत्वं तप एषां सतामिव। मरणं मानुषो भावः परिवादोऽसतामिव॥
en: Yudhishthira said : The study of the Vedas is their divine attribute. Their asceticism is like the virtuous practices of the pious. Death is their human attribute. And slander (by them) is like the behaviour of the impious.

sa: सर्वान् वदेः संजय स्वस्तिमन्तः कृच्छ्रे वासमतदर्हान् निरुष्य। तेषां शान्तिर्विद्यतेऽस्मासु शीघ्रं मिथ्यापेतानामुपकारिणां सताम्॥
en: To all do you, O Sanjaya, communicate our well being. Having resided in the forest and met with troubles, they who are inclined to do good to others without deceit and honest still entertain friendly feeling towards us.

sa: तमाद्रवन्तं संक्रुद्धं मैन्दनीलनलाङ्गदाः। हनूमाञ्जाम्बवांश्चैव ससैन्याः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: As he (Ravana) was furiously advancing, Mainda, Nala, Nila, Angada, Hanuman and Jambavan together with their forces surrounded him.

sa: तूर्णं दशसहस्रेण पार्थमप्रतिमौजसम्। अर्दयित्वा महात्मानं ननर्द समरे कृपः॥ ततः कनकपर्वाग्रैर्वीरः संनतपर्वभिः। त्वरन् गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तैरर्जुनस्तस्य वाजिनः॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरस्तीक्ष्णैरविध्यत् परमेषुभिः। हया निशितैर्बाणैर्व्वलद्भिरिव पन्नगैः। उत्पेतुः सहसा सर्वे कृपः स्थानादथाच्यवत्॥ च्युतं तु गौतमं स्थानात् समीक्ष्य कुरुनन्दनः।
en: Afflicted with those sharpened shafts resembling flame of fire and worked up with anger, Kripa, assailing soon the high-souled Partha of incomparable energy with ten thousand shafts, sent out a war cry in battle. Then the heroic Arjuna taking up his bow speedily bored through the four horses of his enemy with four dreadful straight and gold winged arrows shot from the Gandiva. Then pierced by sharpened arrows resembling flames of fire those horses all on a sudden sprang up and Kripa fell off from his place. Then seeing Gautama dislodged the son of Kunti.

sa: ततस्तन्मतमाज्ञाय संजयस्यात्मजस्य च। अभ्युपेत्य महाप्राज्ञः कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: And knowing that intention of Sanjaya and of his son, the exceedingly wise Krishna Dvaipayana after coming there said-

sa: यत् त्वमेवंगते ब्रूयाः पश्चिमे वयसि स्थितः। शास्त्राद् वा सुप्रतर्काद् वा सुस्थिरः स्थविरोह्यसि॥
en: Having reached the setting part of your life, whatever you say under these circumstances can never be against the holy books, nor against the dictates the dictates of reason; for your mind is clam, as you are aged.

sa: उपवासतप:शीला तत्रास पृथुलेक्षणा। उवास दुःखवसतिं फलमूलकृताशना॥
en: And engaged in austerities and observing fasts, that large-eyed lady began to dwell sorrowfully subsisting on fruits and roots.

sa: द्रौपदीमनुशोचद्भिाह्मणैस्तैः समाहितैः। समिमाय महाप्राज्ञः सभार्यो भ्रातृमध्यगः॥
en: While those self-controlled Brahmanas where lamenting for Draupadi, the greatly wise (king) with his wife and brothers joined them.

sa: इहाहमिच्छामि तवानघान्तिके वस्तुं यथा कामचरस्तथा विभो। तमब्रवीत् स्वागतमित्यनन्तरं राजा प्रहृष्टः प्रतिसंगृहाण च॥
en: O sinless one, I wish to reside with you just like one obeying the voice of his master 0 Lord!" After having accorded him a due welcome the king well pleased said “accept the post you seek for."

sa: कृष्ण उवाच उक्तवानस्मि यद् वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। न तु तन्निकृतिप्रज्ञे कौरव्ये प्रतितिष्ठति।७॥
en: Krishna said The words that you have said consistent with virtue and profit and are indeed to your benefit but then these do not seem acceptable to the son of Kuru, with whom ignorance has now become wisdom.

sa: तरुणादित्यसंकाशं हेमवर्मधरं तथा। मृष्टकुण्डलयुक्तेन वदनेन विराजता॥
en: (Beautiful) as the morning sun, clad in a golden armour and with a beautiful face adorned with brilliant ear-rings.

sa: आपृष्टोऽसि महाबाहो पुनर्चक्ष्यामहे वयम्॥ याह्यविन्नेन वै वीर द्रक्ष्यामस्त्वां समागतम्। आसीनमासने दिव्ये बलतेज:समाहितम्॥
en: You now know our purpose, O you of long arms; and you will again see us. O hero, we will see you come to the Council safely and sealed on a divine seat, endued with strength and prowess.

sa: युक्तः सदाभवच्चापि शक्रो हर्षसमन्वितः। वृत्रस्य वधसंयुक्तानुपायानन्वचिन्तयत्॥
en: Shakra too became delighted and became constantly engaged in the thought of finding out some means of killing Vritra.

sa: धर्मोदयं सुखमाशंसमानाः कृच्छ्रोपायं तत्त्वतः कर्म दुःखम्। सुखं प्रेप्सुर्विजिघांसुश्च दुःखं य इन्द्रियाणां प्रीतिरसानुगामी॥
en: They are men desirous of only such happiness as has its source in virtue. He, who being desirous of happiness and of destroying misery, follows the pleasant dictates of his senses, adopts a way which leads to misery.

sa: यदा विपाठा मद्भुजविप्रमुक्ता द्विजाः फलानीव महीरुहाग्रात्। प्रचेतार उत्तमाङ्गानि यूनां तदा युद्धं धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
en: When the arrows shot by me cut off the five figures of young men on the other side as birds pluck off fruits from the top of trees then will the son of Dhritarashtra repent for the war.

sa: सनत्सुजात उवाच तस्यैव नामादिवेशेषरूपैरिदं जगद् भाति महानुभाव। निर्दिश्य सम्यक् प्रवदन्ति वेदास्तद् विश्वरैरूप्यमुदाहरन्ति॥
en: Sanat-Sujata said This universe shines (has come into existence) from the Supreme Soul and is distinct from the latter in name, form etc. The Vedas, too, pointing this out declare that the universe is distant (from Supreme Soul).

sa: स्वसेनया सम्प्रयान्तं नानुयान्ति स्म पृष्ठतः। शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च संयुगेष्वपलायिनः॥ भवतस्ते सहाया वै प्रेष्यतां पूर्वमागताः। पाण्डवेयानि रत्नानि त्वमद्याप्युपभुञ्जसे॥ सत्त्वस्थान् पाण्डवान् पश्य न ते प्रायमुपाविशन् उत्तिष्ठ राजन् भद्रं ते न चिरं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: That they did not follow you when you marched to battle at the head of your troops. They have long before come under your power by becoming your slaves. Endued as they are with courage and prowess and incapable as they are to turn back from the field of battle they are bound to help you. You are now enjoying all the rich possessions of the Pandavas; O king, see, the Pandavas are yet active. They have not resolved to die by fasting. Rise, () king, be blessed; you should not grieve.

sa: इत्युक्ते धृतराष्ट्रेण क्षत्तापि विदुरोऽब्रवीत्। दुर्योधनमभिप्रेत्य धार्तराष्ट्रपमर्षणम्॥
en: This being said Dhritarashtra the Kshatta Vidura too said, with his eyes on the wrathful son of Dhritarashtra, Duryodhana.

sa: महर्षिकल्पो राजर्षिः सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतः। बलवान् धृतिमान् दक्षः सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः। धनैश्च सञ्चयैश्चैव शक्रवैश्रवणोपमः॥
en: A royal saint like a great Rishi as he is, he is celebrated all over the world. He is powerful, intelligent, capable, truthful and selfcontrolled. In wealth he is equal to Indra and in amassed wealth to Kubera,

sa: एवं प्राप्स्यसि कल्याणि कल्याणमनघे ध्रुवम्। कोपिते च द्विजश्रेष्ठे कृत्स्नं दह्येत मे कुलम्॥
en: By acting in such a way, O auspicious and sinless girl, you will certainly attain to blissfulness. But if you stir up the wrath of this foremost of the twice born ones, he will consume my entire race."

sa: तमभ्येत्याशु हरयः परिवः समन्ततः। अभ्यघ्नंश्च महाकायैर्बहुभिर्जगतीरुहै:॥
en: The monkeys, (then), coming up to him completely surrounded him and began to smite him with numerous huge trees.

sa: विधाय तच्चायुधमाजिवर्धनं कुरूत्तमानामिषुधीः शरांस्तथा। प्रायात् स मत्स्यो नगरं प्रहृष्टः किरीटिना सारथिना महात्मना॥
en: Then, having kept, as before, the arrows and quivers of those great Pandu princes and also the other weapon (Gandiva) which makes the battle dreadful, the Matsya Prince, having Kiritin for his charioteer, gladly started for his city.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच राज्ञस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। कृष्णा दाशार्हमासीनमब्रवीच्छोककर्शिता॥ सुता दुपदराजस्य स्वसितायतमूर्धजा। सम्पूज्य सहदेवं च सात्यकिं च महारथम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the king's words which were beneficial as well as conducive to morality and worldly good, Krishna, the daughter of king Drupada, of long and very black tresses, afflicted with grief, said to the scion of the Dasharha race, who was seated there, after having given due respects to Sahadeva and the great car-warrior Satyaki.

sa: धर्मराजश्चधौम्यश्च निलिल्याते महावने। अग्निहोत्राण्युपादाय सहदेवस्तु पर्वते॥
en: Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) and Dhaumya crept into a deep wood. Taking the sacred fire, Sahadeva took shelter under a rock.

sa: सर्वे च देवा मुदिताः प्रहृष्टा महर्षयश्चेन्द्रभिष्टुवन्तः। सर्वांश्च दैत्यांस्त्वरिताः समेत्य जघ्नुः सुरा वृत्रवधाभितप्तान्॥
en: The celestials and the great Rishis were all filled with joy and they cheerfully sang the praise of Indra. Then the celestials mustering together began to kill all the Daityas who grew dejected by the death of Vitra.

sa: ततस्तदस्त्रं कौन्तेयधूतं तूलमिवानलैः। तथा तदभवद् युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। लब्धालोकस्तु राजेन्द्र पुनः शत्रुमयोधयम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, that weapon rushed onwards like flakes of cotton blown away by the winds. Tlien a great and hair-stirring battle took place. O king of kings, having rcguined light, I again fought with the enemy.

sa: वेश्योवाच कच्चिन्मुने कुशलं तापसानां कच्चिच्च वो मूलफलं प्रभूतम्। स्त्वां वै द्रष्टुं साम्प्रतमागतोऽस्मि॥
en: The Courtesan said : O Rishi, I hope it all well with the ascetics here; I hope fruits and roots are plentiful here; I hope take delight in this hermitage. I have come to pay you a visit.

sa: सर्प उवाच यदि ते वृत्ततो राजन् ब्राह्मणः प्रसमीक्षितः। वृथा जातिस्तदाऽऽयुष्मन् कृतिर्यावन्न विद्यते॥
en: The serpent said : If, O monarch, as you assert, a Brahmana is recognised by certain virtues, then, O longlived one, the distinction of castes is to no purpose so long as he does not posses these qualities.

sa: न दिष्टमर्थमत्येतुमीशो मर्त्यः कथंचन। महिषैर्भेदयामासधनुषाक्षो महीधरान्॥
en: "On no condition can a mortal overcome what has been ordained by Fate. Dhanushakha shattered even mountain by buffaloes.”

sa: शक्तितो ब्राह्मणान् नूनं रक्षितुं प्रयतामहे। तद् वै वित्तं मातिदेवीर्मा जैषीः शकुने परान्॥
en: O Shakuni, by playing disparately do not deceitfully win from us that wealth with which according to our ability we try to benefit the Brahmanas. Even enemies should not be vanquished by desperate stakes in a deceitful play.

sa: मुष्टिभिश्च महाघोरैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः। ततः कटकटाशब्दो बभूव सुमहात्मनोः॥
en: They administered each other terrible blows; and those two greatly powerful heroes made chattering sounds by knashing their teeth.

sa: सत्यव्रतधराः सर्वे सर्वे पुरुषमानिनः। हन्तारो देवशत्रूणां रक्षसां कामरूपिणाम्॥ हिडिम्बबकमुख्यानां किर्मीरस्य च रक्षसः।
en: They are all truthful and proud of their manliness. They have killed the enemies of the celestials, the Rakshasas, who are able to assume.any from at will. (The Rakshasas) such as were headed by Hidimba, Baka and Kirmira.

sa: समापयामास च तं राजसूयं महाक्रतुम्। तं तु यज्ञं महाबाहुरासमाप्तेर्जनार्दनः। ररक्ष भगवाञ्छौरिः शाईचक्रगदाधरः॥
en: So long the great Rajasuya sacrifice was not completed, the mighty armed Janardana, the illustrious Shauri (Krishna), guarded it with his bow, called Sharanga, and with his discus and club, and thus in due time it was completed.

sa: अग्निरास्यं क्षितिः पादौ चन्द्रादित्यौ च लोचने। द्यौर्मूर्धा खं दिशः श्रोत्रे तथाऽप: स्वेदसम्भवाः॥
en: Fire is my mouth, the earth my feet, the sun and the moon are my eyes, the heaven is my head, the sky and the directions are my ears. And the waters are my sweats (of the body).

sa: श्वापदैर्व्यालरूपैश्च रुरुभिश्च निषेवितम्। फुल्लैः सहस्रपत्रैश्च शतपत्रैस्तथोत्पलैः॥
en: And by all sorts of ferocious animals and Rurus; decked with full-blown lotuses of a thousand and hundred petals,

sa: एवमुत्तमकर्माणमनुशिष्य युधिष्ठिरम्। श्वेतं गिरिवरश्रेष्ठं प्रययौ गुह्यकाधिपः॥
en: The lord of the Guhyakas having thus instructed Yudhishthira, disposed to good deeds, vanished from that excellent of mountains.

sa: अनुज्ञाताश्च गन्धर्वाश्चित्रसेनेन भारत॥ प्रगृहीतायुधाः सर्वे धार्तराष्ट्रानभिद्रवन्।
en: O descendant of Bharata, thus commanded by Chitrasena, the Gandharvas, rushed towards ihe Dhritarashtra people with weapons in hand.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच स्वयंवरे यास्मि नृपैदृष्टा रङ्गे समागतैः। न दृष्टपूर्वा चान्यत्र साहमद्य सभां गता॥
en: Draupadi said I was once seen on the occasion of my Svamavara by the assembled kings in the arena. I was never before seen (by them) any where else. I am to day been brought before the assembly.

sa: सुमुहूर्तं तु तद् युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम्। भुजप्रहारसंयुक्तं वृत्रवासवयोरिव॥
en: That fearful and hair-stirring fight with fists, resembling that of Vasava (Indra) and Vitra, lasted only for a moment.

sa: गङ्गाद्याः सलिलोच्चयाः। पयोष्णी चैकतः पुण्या तीर्थेभ्यो हि मता मम॥ एकतः सरितः सर्वा
en: Placing on the one scale Ganga and all the other rivers with their waters and on the other, the Payoshini, the latter in my opinion would be superior in point of merit to all the Tirthas put together.

sa: अयं पुरुषशार्दूल: सायुधोऽजिनसंवृतः। यच्चिकीर्षुरिह प्राप्तस्तत् सम्प्रष्टुमिहार्हथ॥
en: “You should enquire why this foremost of mien, clad in deer skins and armed with weapons, has come here."

sa: तथा यमौ चाप्यसुखौ सुखार्हो समृद्धरूपावमरौ दिवीव। प्रजागरस्थौ ध्रुवमप्रशान्तौ धर्मेण सत्येन च वार्यमाणौ॥
en: The twins also, who are even like a couple of blessed celestials in heaven, sunk in misery though deserving of happiness and comfort, certainly pass their nights without sleep, only restrained from taking revenge by virtue and truth.

sa: ततश्चिन्तयमानस्य गुडाकेशस्यधीमतः। रथो मातलिसंयुक्त आजगाम महाप्रभः॥
en: While the intelligent (Arjuna) of controlled senses was thinking, the highly-effulgent car having Matali as its charioteer came there.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच दयावान् सर्वभूतेषु हितो रक्तोऽनसूयकः॥
en: Markandeya said : Be king to all creatures and be devoted to their good. Love all without hating anyone.

sa: एनं त्वहरहर्मेसं सूर्याचन्द्रमसौध्रुवम्। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य कुरुतः कुरुनन्दन।॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, the sun and the moon, through eternity, make their tour around this Meru every day.

sa: लोकपालोपमान् वीरान् पुन: परमसंहतान्। कथं च वशगास्तुभ्यं न कुप्यन्ति च ते शुभे॥
en: Those heroes who are endued with great strength and beauty and who are like the Lokapalas themselves. O beautiful lady, how is it that they are so obedient to you and that they are never angry with you?

sa: तत्र शूलगदापाणियूंढोरस्को महाभुजः। सखा वैश्रवणस्यासीन्मणिमात्राम राक्षसः॥
en: On that side, stood the mighty-armed and broad-chested Rakshasa, Maniman, the friend of Kubera, armed with darts and maces.

sa: असम्भ्रान्तस्तदा राजन् पिता देवव्रतस्तव।॥ अष्टभिर्नवभिर्भीष्मः शक्तिं चिच्छेद पत्रिभिः। उत्कृष्टहेमविकृतां निकृतां निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Your father Devavrata, then, without the slightest fcar, with eight sharp and winged arrows, cut down into nine parts that fearful dart which was decked with pure gold and which appeared to be covered with flames of fire.

sa: चित्राङ्गदं कौरवाणामाधिपत्येऽभ्यषेचयम्। विचित्रवीर्यं च शिशुं यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयम्॥
en: I installed Chitrangada in the lordship over the Kauravas and also installed the infant Vichitravirya as the heir presumptive,

sa: स्रस्तहस्तैश्च मातङ्गैः शयानैर्विबभौ मही। नानारूपैरलंकारैः प्रमदैवाभ्यलकृता॥
en: With trunkless elephants, scattered on the field, the earth appeared charming like a damsel adorned with various of ornaments.

sa: बहूनप्याविशन्मोहो भीरून् हृदयदुर्बलान्। सर्वमाविग्नमभवन प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: Everything rolled in confusion and nothing could be distinguished. Soldiers enveloped in dust fought on regardless of one another.

sa: धन्यः कुन्तीसुतो राजा सुजातं चास्य धीमतः। अज्ञातशत्रुता सत्या तस्य यत् स्निह्यते भवान्॥
en: Praised be that king the son of Kunti. The birth of that intelligent one was auspicious. The fact of his being Ajatasatru (having no enemy) is verified today, in as much as even you are affectionate towards him.

sa: प्रेषिताश्च ग्रमहामात्रैर्वारणाः परवारणैः। अभ्यघ्नन्त विषाणाग्रैर्वारणानेव संयुगे।॥
en: Goaded on by their riders, elephants slew their hostile compeers with the ends of their tusks, in that battle.

sa: स्तस्मात् पुत्रं मा शुचोराजसिंह। स्वर्गे प्राप्तो मोदते ते तनूजो नित्यं रम्यान् वीरलोकानवाप्य॥
en: Even all the gods and qualified with the adjective mortal. Therefore, o foremost of kings, do not bewail you son. Your son having ascended to heaven, is enjoying perpetual happiness, in those delightful regions allotted to the heroes.

sa: अतीव हृष्टाः श्वशृगालवायसा बकाः सुपर्णाश्च वृकास्तरक्षवः। वयांस्यसृक्पान्यथ रक्षसां गणाः पिशाचसंघाश्च सुदारुणा रणे॥
en: Greatly delighted dogs, jackals and crows and numerous other flesh-eating birds and wolves and hyenas and ravens and other blooddrinking animals animals and various clans of Rakshasas and large bodies of Pisachas, repairing to the field of battle.

sa: अङ्गदोऽभिमुखं वीरमुत्तमौजसमाहवे। द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं शरौघेण न्यवारयत्॥
en: Angada checked the heroic Uttamaujasa, with a down-pour of arrows, as the latter advanced in that battle against Drona.

sa: सभिन्दिपालाः सप्रासा: सशक्त्यृष्टिपरश्वधाः। सनियूहाः सनिस्त्रिंशाः सशरासनतोमराः॥
en: Holding Bhindipalas or lances or darts or swords or battle-axes or piked stakes or scimitars or bows or Tomaras.

sa: दुर्योधनो महाराज राक्षसान् समुपाद्रवत्। अमर्षवशमापन्नस्त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः॥
en: Duryodhana himself, O mighty monarch, rushed against the Rakshasas, influenced by great animosity and headless of his own life.

sa: तस्य सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे। घटोत्कचस्य विजयमात्मनश्च पराजयम्॥
en: Began to describe everything that had taken place, namely, victory by Ghatotkacha, and the defeat he himself has suffered.

sa: ततस्ते भ्रातरः पञ्च राक्षसेन्द्रं महाहवे। विव्यधुनिशितैर्वाणैस्तपनीयविभूषितैः॥
en: Thereafter the brothers, in that fierce conflict, that foremost of the Rakshasas, with whetted shafts furnished with golden wings.

sa: त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानां त्वं नेता त्वं जगद्गुरुः। त्वत्प्रसादेन देवेश सुखिनो विबुधाः सदा॥
en: You are the refuge of all created beings and you are their bodies! You have the universe for your mouth; O you that are the Lord of the celestials, the gods are ever happy through your grace only.

sa: ततो नकुलदायादस्त्रिभिर्भल्लैः सुसंशितैः। चक्रे विवाहुशिरसं भूतकर्माणमाहवे॥
en: Thereat the son of Nakula with three wellsharpened Bhallas (broad-headed arrows). Made Bhutakarma headless and armless in that battle.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम सौमदत्तेः पराक्रमम्। यदेको बहुभिर्युद्धे समसज्जदभीतवत्॥
en: There we saw wonderful prowess of Bhurishrava, the son of Somadatti, who was fighting alone with many without fear.

sa: प्रतिविन्ध्यस्ततो रक्षो बिभेद निशितैः शरैः। सर्वपारशवैस्तूर्णैरकुण्ठागैर्महाबलः॥
en: Then the highly powerful Prativindhya penetrated the Rakshasas with whetted arrows, sharp as battle axes and with keen points.

sa: पिता सुतं त्यजति सुहृद्वरं सुहृत् तथैव पुत्रः पितरं शरातुरः। स्त्यजन्ति वाहानपि पार्थपीडिताः॥
en: Afflicted with arrows, then father deserted his son, friend forsook his friend and son abandoned his father. Then with their hearts intent on saying themselves, men even forsook their very vehicles, being pained by the arrows of Partha.

sa: पुरापि चैषामनुसृत्य भूमिपाः पुरेषु भोगानखिलान् जयन्ति। पुरेषु नीति विहितां यथाविधि प्रयोजयन्तो बलवृत्रसूदन॥
en: Kings, O killer of Vala and Vritra, pursuing their enemies and entering their towers, seize and appropriate the best things that are to be had there, and adopt proper measures of policy in their own cities and dominions.

sa: जितानि परराष्ट्रानि स्वराष्ट्रमनुपालितम्॥ भुक्ताश्च विविधा भोगास्त्रिवर्ग: सेवितो मया। पितॄणां गतमानृण्यं क्षत्रधर्मस्य चोभयोः॥
en: I have conquered foreign kingdoms. I have properly guverned by own kingdom. I have enjoyed various luxuries. I have pursued religion, profit and desire. I have paid off my debt to the departed manes and to Kshatriya duty.

sa: विनाशे बहवो दोषा जीवन् प्राप्नोति भद्रकम्। तस्मात् प्राणान् धरिष्यामि ध्रुवो जीवति संगमः॥
en: Incalculable are the ills of my putting a period to my existence; (on the other hand) if I live, I imay come by good. Therefore my life I will maintain. If I live, it may conduce to happiness."

sa: त्रीणि सादिसहस्राणि दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः। शककाम्बोजबाह्रीका यवनाः पारदास्तथा॥
en: Three thousand bowmen, commanded by Duryodhana himself and supported by a numerous body of Sakas, Kambojas, Valhikas, Yavanas, Paradas.

sa: यथा पाण्डोः सुता राजंस्तथैव तव धर्मतः। तान् पालय स्थितो धर्मे गुरुशुश्रूषणे रतान्॥
en: Yuthishthira and his brothers are morally as much your sons as are the sons of Pandu. Following the duties of religion, cherish and protect them. In their turn, they are always devoted to the service of their elders.

sa: शरैश्च मेऽर्थो बहुभिरक्षयैः क्षिप्रमस्यतः। न हि वोढुं रथः शक्तः शरान् मम यथेप्सितान्॥
en: In consequence of the great lightness of my hands, I require arrows that will be inexhaustible (in the quiver). My car also is hardly able to bear the load of arrows that I desire to keep by me.

sa: आवर्जिता इवाभान्ति नीपाश्चित्रककौकुराः। कारस्कारा लोहजङ्घा युधिष्ठिरनिवेशने॥
en: The Nipas, the Chitrakas, the Kukuras, the Karaskaras and the Lohajanghas are living in the Yudhishthira's palace like bondsmen.

sa: सुरूपा बहुरूपाश्च तथा कल्माषकुण्डलाः। आदित्यवन्नाकपृष्ठे रेजुरैरावतोद्भवाः॥
en: Beautiful, variously formed, decked with many coloured ear-rings, children of Airavata, you shine like the sun in the sky.

sa: ऋषींश्च देवांश्च महासुरांश्च त्रैविद्यवृद्धांश्च वने मुनींश्च। कानापदो नोपनमन्ति लोके परावरज्ञास्तु न सम्भ्रमन्ति॥
en: Who is there amongst Rishis, gods, great Asuras, persons fully conversant with the three Vedas, and hermits living in the forest, whom calamities do not approach? Those, however, who know well, the Soul and not-Soul never fear calamities.

sa: राजमानाश्च निस्त्रिंशाः संसिक्ता नरशोणितैः। प्रत्यदृश्यन्त शूराणामन्योन्मभिधावताम्॥
en: The swords of brave combatants who rushed against one another having been steeped in blood shone with great brilliancy.

sa: भवानर्धरथो मह्यं मतो वै नात्र संशयः। सर्वस्य जगतश्चैव गाङ्गेयो न मृषा वदेत्॥
en: In my opinion you too are only half a Ratha, there is no doubt about this. O son of Ganga, I do not speak an untruth when I say that you are an enemy of the entire universe.

sa: देवयान्युवाच स्तुवतो दुहिताहं ते याचतः प्रतिगृह्णतः । स्तूयमानस्य दुहिता कथं दासी भविष्यसि॥
en: Devayani said: I am the daughter of one who is a hired chanter of praise, who asks for alms and accepts them, whereas you are the daughter of one who is adored. Why should you become my maid-servant?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धर्माधर्मविमुक्तं यद् विमुक्तं सर्वसंशयात्। जन्ममृत्युविमुक्तं च विमुक्तं पुण्यपापयोः॥ यच्छिवं नित्यमभयं नित्यमक्षरमव्ययम्। शुचि नित्यमनायासं तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: You should, O grandfather, describe to me what is freed from duty and its reverse, what is freed from every doubt, what is above birth and death, as also virtue and sin, what is auspiciousness, what is eternal fearlessness, what is Eternal and Indestructible, and Immutable, what is always Pure, and what is ever free from exertion.

sa: तथा सत्यं समाख्याहि जिहीर्षाम्याश्रमादिमाम्। समन्युस्तत्र हृदयं प्रदहन्निव तिष्ठति। मत्पूर्वाभार्यां यदिमां भृगुराप सुमध्यमाम्॥
en: As I have found her alone in the hermitage, I am determined to carry her away by force. My heart burns with rage when I think that Bhrigu has obtained this beautiful woman who was betrothed to me.

sa: सजश्च विविधाकारा जगृहुस्त्वभिमन्त्रिताः॥ संग्रामसज्जाः संहृष्टा धारयनराक्षसास्तदा।
en: The Raksasas, inspired with martial ardour, put on diverse garlands, consecrated with scriptural formulae; and donned on their armour.

sa: समीक्ष्य संख्येऽतिबलान् नराधिपान् ससूतमातङ्गरथान् परैर्हतान्। कथं न सर्वानहितान् रणेऽवधीद् महास्त्रविद् ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवो गुरुः॥
en: Well-versed in the use of powerful weapons and himself the foremost of Brahmanas why did not the preceptor kill in battle all the enemies who killed the most powerful of our hero with their drivers, elephants and chariots?

sa: ततोऽहं मातलेौर्यमपश्यं परमाद्भुतम्। अश्वांस्तथा वेगवतो यदयत्नादधारयत्॥
en: Then the prowess of Matali appeared highly wonderful to me in that he guided the swift steeds with ease.

sa: महान्तं नरकं घोरमप्रतिष्ठमचेतनम्। पतन्ति चिररात्राय राजवित्तापहारिणः॥
en: Those, who take wealth belonging to the king, sink senseless into a deep hell of eternal darkness and infamy.

sa: स शापदृष्टिमुख्यस्य दीर्घ तम उपेयिवान्। स हि दीर्घतमा नाम नाम्ना ह्यासीदृषिः पुरा
en: Through this curse of the foremost of Rishis, the child of Utathya was born blind and remained so for a long time. It was, therefore, that that Rishi, in days of yore, passed by the name of Dirghatamas.

sa: यास्यन्ति दूताः शीघ्रजवैर्हयैः। भरतं मातुलकुलादिहावर्तयुतं नराः॥
en: Let it be that messengers with fast going steeds shall go to bring Bharata from his maternal uncle's residence.

sa: गच्छन्नेव महाबाहुर्युतिमान् भरतस्तदा। शत्रुघ्नं चाब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तानमात्यांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: As he proceeded, the intelligent and mightyarmed Bharata with a cheerful heart remarked to Śatrughna and all the courtiers.

sa: ततः सुग्रीवसचिवा दृष्ट्वा परमधन्विनौ। जन्मुर्गिरितटा तस्मादन्यच्छिखरमुत्तमम्॥
en: Beholding these two mighty archers the counsellors of Sugriva, quitting that mountainous expanse proceeded to another best of hills.

sa: सुमतिस्तु महातेजा विश्वामित्रमुपागतम्। श्रुत्वा नरवरश्रेष्ठः प्रत्यागच्छन्महायशाः॥
en: And having heard that the illustrious Viśvāmitra had come, that best of kings, the effulgent Sumati, appeared before him.

sa: युवां वर्णान् विकुस्थो विश्वरूपां स्तेऽधिक्षियन्ते भुवनानि विश्वा। ते भानवोऽप्यनुसृताश्चरन्ति देवा मनुष्याः क्षितिमाचरन्ति॥
en: Mixing the ten colours, you have produced all the objects of form. The universe has sprung from these objects in which both the celestials and men and all creatures endued with life are engaged in their respective works.

sa: अनन्तबलवीर्यश्च अनन्तबलपौरुषः। वीरभद्र इति ख्यातो देव्या मन्युप्रमार्जकः॥ सोऽसृजद् रोमकूपेभ्यो रौम्यान् नाम गणेश्वरान्।
en: Of great might, energy, courage and prowess, he passed by the of Virabhadra—that dispeller of the goddess's anger. He then created from the pores of his body a large number of spirits known by the name of Raumyas.

sa: मातङ्गाश्चाप्यदृश्यन्त शरतोमरपीडिताः। पतन्तस्तत्र तत्रैव छिन्नाभ्रसदृशा रणे॥
en: Elephants also, wounded with arrows and lances, dropped down here and there like broken clouds dropped from the sky.

sa: एवं समाधिना युक्तस्तेजसाप्रतिमेन च। शिक्षास्वरसमायुक्तं सुव्रतश्चाब्रवीन्मुनिः॥
en: Thus, furnished with unrivalled ascetic energy, did that anchorite observing excellent vows, express himself orthoepically in consonance with Śikṣā.

sa: निपात्यमाने हाहाकृते तव पुत्रस्य सैन्ये। स शाल्वराजस्य शिनिप्रवीरो जहार भल्लेन शिरः शितेन॥
en: While that best of elephants was falling down and while your son's ariny were bewailing at the spectacle, that best of warriors among the Shinis cut off the head of king Shalya with a sharp and broad-headed arrow.

sa: तेषामसह्यवीर्याणां शौर्यधैर्यधृति पराम्। अन्योन्यमनुरागं च भ्रातृणामतिमानुषम्॥
en: And thinking of the heroism, patience superior fortitude and the extraordinary mutual love of those brothers of unbearable prowess.

sa: रुद्रेण सह देवेश तन्निबोध शचीपते। पर्वतारोहणं कृत्वा एकपादो विभावसुम्॥ निरीक्षेत निराहार उर्ध्वबाहुः कृताञ्जलिः। तपसा महता युक्त उपवासफलं लभेत्॥
en: O king of the celestials do you hear it with Rudra in your company, O lord of Shachi. If a person, ascending a mountain stands there on one foot, with arms upraised and joined together and abstaining from food, looks at a burning fire, he acquires the merits of severe penances and obtains the rewards of fasts.

sa: नदीष्वापो यथा युक्ता यथा सूर्ये मरीचयः। संततत्वाद् यथा यान्ति तथा देहाः शरीरिणाम्॥
en: Water must exits in rivers. Rays of light are always attached to the sun. Similarly, thc Soul has a body. This connection is not stopped because of the constant succession of bodies that Soul has to pass through.

sa: अनसूया क्षमा शान्तिः संतोष: प्रियवादिता। कामक्रोधपरित्याग: शिष्टाचारनिषेवणम्॥ कर्म च श्रुतसम्पन्नं सतां मार्गमनुत्तमम्।
en: Harmlessness, forgiveness, peacefulness, contentment, agreeable speech, giving away passions and excitements, the service of the virtuous characters and actions performed in accordance with the dictates of the Shastra constitute the superior path of the honest and the wise.

sa: यथा च वेदान् सावित्री याज्ञसेनी तथा पतीन्। न जहौधर्मतः पार्थान् मेरुमर्कप्रभा यथा॥
